sources.snippet: In this release we are opening the weights of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, a multimodal MoE model that also serves as an early preview of the architecture used in Qwen4. It plays the same role that Qwen3-Next played for Qwen3.5: the hybrid Gated DeltaNet + Gated Attention design introduced at that time has since been used across the Qwen3.5, Qwen3.6, Qwen3.7 and Qwen3.8 series. sources.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next: How to Run Locally - unsloth.ai
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next is a new open-weight, 125B parameter MoE multimodal model from Qwen. Built on the new Qwen4 architecture, it supports a 262K context window and advanced reasoning. It can run locally on devices with 78GB RAM /unified memory without requiring GPU VRAM. The model outperforms Claude-4.6-Opus (Max) at agentic coding, vision, and chat. sources.snippet: Overview Qwen3.8-Flash-Next is a multimodal, ultra-sparse Mixture-of-Experts model. It has 125B parameters, including an additional 51B N-gram embedding table, while activating 6B parameters per token. The architecture combines four main ideas: GDN + QSA: three of every four layers use Gated DeltaNet to compress history; the fourth uses Qwen Sparse Attention for precise long-range retrieval ...

sources.title: Qwen3.8-Flash - QwenCloud
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-Flash is the latest multimodal model from the Qwen family, combining powerful reasoning and generation with remarkable speed. It natively supports a million-token context window, allowing it to process lengthy documents, entire codebases, and complex conversations in a single pass.
